title: Increase Time Machine range to support all weekly reports in Drive folder (back to Week 5) with historical Sheet synchronization
description: Expand the Time Machine range to encompass all weekly reporting packs available in the Google Drive folder dating back to Week 5 (rather than only Weeks 22-26). Maintain historical risk/issue register snapshots matching each historical time machine date so that traveling back in time renders the full state of both the briefing deck and the risk register for that specific week.

title: Update server startup output to print clickable dashboard URL
description: Update the server to print the URL that I can click to get to the dashboard.
cause: server.py prints 'Serving Project Dash with Drive Ingestion & Sync API on port 9000...' without formatting the explicit clickable HTTP URL (http://localhost:9000).
plan: Update server.py __main__ block to print explicit http://localhost:9000 and http://127.0.0.1:9000 links on server startup so users in modern terminals/IDEs can click directly into the dashboard.
resolution_notes: Implemented get_startup_urls and get_startup_banner in server.py to print formatted clickable URLs (http://localhost:9000 and http://127.0.0.1:9000) along with API sync endpoints upon startup. Verified with tests/test_server.py.

title: Clean up unhandled KeyboardInterrupt traceback when stopping server via Ctrl+C
description: When stopping server.py using CTRL-C, Python dumps an unhandled KeyboardInterrupt stack traceback instead of exiting cleanly with a graceful shutdown message.
cause: server.py executes httpd.serve_forever() without catching KeyboardInterrupt or SystemExit, causing standard Python stack trace output upon Ctrl+C.
plan: Wrap httpd.serve_forever() in try...except (KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit) in server.py, perform clean socket shutdown, and log a friendly exit message.
resolution_notes: Wrapped socketserver loop in try...except (KeyboardInterrupt, SystemExit) with clean console exit banner.

title: Week 27 report pack in Google Drive folder is not detected/activated upon 'Sync Workspace'
description: Week 27 pack was added to the drive folder. The file is visible in Drive scan, but clicking 'Sync Workspace' leaves the dashboard showing Week 26 instead of updating the live dashboard view to Week 27.
cause:
1. DRIVE_REPORTS in index.html is statically seeded through Week 26.
2. syncGoogleSheet() fetches /api/sync-sheet (which lacked snapshots) and calls checkDriveSyncStatus() but never updates activeTimeMachineWeek or executes activateTimeMachine(getLatestWeekKey()).
3. Header report buttons (#driveReportLink), live status pill (#liveStatusBadge), and Time Machine return banner contained hardcoded Week 26 text instead of dynamically updating to the latest ingested snapshot.
plan:
1. In server.py, include snapshots payload in /api/sync-sheet response.
2. In index.html, update DRIVE_REPORTS to include Week 27 (1HBfI9itx3BER4IRnH9eavBgAsrDGHnmu).
3. In syncGoogleSheet() and initApp(), dynamically sync TIME_MACHINE_SNAPSHOTS from server response and automatically invoke activateTimeMachine(getLatestWeekKey()) to switch the entire dashboard to Week 27.
4. Dynamically update #driveReportLink href/text to always point to the latest week's Drive pack.
5. Write automated reproduction test verifying that syncWorkspace/syncGoogleSheet updates active week to Week 27.
resolution_notes:
1. Updated /api/sync-sheet in server.py to bundle snapshots dictionary.
2. Updated DRIVE_REPORTS in index.html to include Week 27 pack.
3. Updated syncGoogleSheet() and initApp() in index.html to update TIME_MACHINE_SNAPSHOTS and automatically invoke activateTimeMachine(getLatestWeekKey()).
4. Made header link, return to present button, and live status badge dynamic across snapshots.
5. Added and verified 9 unit tests across server startup, sync APIs, and Week 27 ingestion.

title: 'undefined' displayed instead of week labels in Time Machine modal list
description: In the F-DSE Governance Time Machine modal list, historical weekly snapshot items display 'undefined (31 Jul 2026)', 'undefined (24 Jul 2026)', 'undefined (17 Jul 2026)', 'undefined (10 Jul 2026)', and 'undefined (03 Jul 2026)' instead of proper week names (e.g. 'Week 26', 'Week 25').
cause: In weekly_snapshots.json (and TIME_MACHINE_SNAPSHOTS), historical snapshots w26 through w22 define 'weekLabel' and 'weekNumber' rather than 'week'. In index.html, renderTimeMachineModalList() accesses '${snap.week}', which evaluates to undefined when 'week' is undefined on older snapshots.
plan:
1. In index.html, update renderTimeMachineModalList() (and related snapshot accessors) to robustly resolve week names via `snap.week || snap.weekLabel || ('Week ' + (snap.weekNumber || ''))`.
2. In src/data/weekly_snapshots.json, normalize all snapshot entries to include both 'week' and 'weekLabel'.
3. Add an automated test in tests/test_server.py asserting no undefined labels appear in snapshot modal rendering.
resolution_notes:
1. Updated renderTimeMachineModalList() and activateTimeMachine() in index.html to resolve week names with fallback: `snap.week || snap.weekLabel || ('Week ' + (snap.weekNumber || ''))`.
2. Normalized all snapshot records in weekly_snapshots.json to include both 'week' and 'weekLabel'.
3. Added automated unit tests in tests/test_server.py verifying all snapshots define valid week names and fallback logic works properly.

title: Bad text wrapping in Executive Cockpit KPI status pill (ATO-C GATE)
description: In the Executive Cockpit top banner, the ATO-C GATE KPI badge has bad text wrapping where 'ATO-C GATE:' wraps across 3 awkward vertical lines ('ATO-', 'C', 'GATE:') causing excessive vertical height and misaligned pills.
cause: In updateAtoGateKpi(statusText), cardKpiAto.className dynamically overwrote the element's class list with classes that dropped 'whitespace-nowrap' and 'shrink-0' and increased padding/font size (px-3 py-1.5 text-xs vs px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px]), causing the label 'ATO-C Gate:' to wrap across 3 lines in standard viewports.
plan: Add 'whitespace-nowrap shrink-0' to all 4 KPI pill wrappers and inner label spans in #execKpisGrid, and harmonize updateAtoGateKpi() to retain 'px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap shrink-0'.
resolution_notes:
1. Added whitespace-nowrap and shrink-0 to all 4 KPI pill wrappers and child spans in #execKpisGrid.
2. Harmonized updateAtoGateKpi() to maintain consistent px-2.5 py-1 text-[11px] whitespace-nowrap shrink-0.
3. Verified with automated unit test test_kpi_pill_wrapping_classes.

title: Add 'Create a Slide' button near 'Copy Synthesis' to generate presentation slides from executive summary panels
description: Add a 'Create a slide' button near 'Copy Synthesis' to make presentation slides from the executive summary. Perhaps several slides, 1 for each panel on that page.
cause: Executive Briefing card currently provides 'Copy Briefing Text' and 'Generate Audio Briefing' but lacks an automated presentation slide export for individual panels or full executive decks.
plan: Add a '📊 Create Slide Deck' button in the executive briefing toolbar near 'Copy Synthesis'. Build an interactive slide generator modal and PPTX/HTML export supporting 4 structured slide layouts (Slide 1: Executive Cockpit & KPIs, Slide 2: Gemini Decision Briefing, Slide 3: Top 3 Actions & Outliers, Slide 4: Gap Close Glidepaths).

title: Clicking on Risk Volume or Risk Mitigation (Burndown) graphs in Performance Trends tab does not drill down
description: On the Performance Trends tab (Tab 4), clicking on data points or bars in the Risk Volume (Backlog Timeline) and Risk Mitigation (Burndown Timeline) graphs does not trigger drill-down or time travel navigation.
cause: Chart.js instances for chartBacklogTimeline and chartBurndownTimeline lacked 'interaction: { mode: "index", intersect: false }' and 'events: ["click", "mousemove"]', requiring pixel-perfect clicks on thin lines or points. Additionally, clicking points only triggered a toast rather than opening a rich interactive weekly volume drill-down modal.
plan:
1. Configure 'interaction: { mode: "index", intersect: false }' on both Chart.js instances so clicking anywhere in the column slice fires reliably.
2. Implement openTimelineDrilldownModal(weekKey, metrics) presenting the full weekly breakdown of active risks, opened/closed counts, and score averages with a 1-click 'Travel to Week' action.
resolution_notes:
1. Added interaction: { mode: 'index', intersect: false } to chartBacklogTimeline and chartBurndownTimeline so clicking anywhere in a week column triggers the click handler.
2. Built #timelineDrilldownModal and openTimelineDrilldownModal(index, metrics) displaying comprehensive week performance metrics with 1-click 'Travel to Week' and 'Open Risk Explorer' actions.
3. Verified with automated unit test test_timeline_drilldown_modal_and_interaction.

title: Margins are too big on wide screen displays

title: Executive Cockpit top header banner and KPI pills are not clickable
description: The Executive Cockpit top header bar and its 4 KPI cards (Overall Program status, Commercial, Milestone 2 IBR, ATO-C Security Gate, Escalations) are currently static and should be interactive/clickable (e.g. clicking week/program status opens the Time Machine / report snapshot modal, clicking Escalations filters issues, clicking ATO-C / Milestone 2 jumps to Driver Tree gates).

plan: Standardize renderTeamGoogleHeatmap() to match the primary 5x5 matrix layout (large score typography, circular count badges, axis labels, active cell highlighting) with Google Blue delivery branding.

title: Clicking 'Filter Risk Matrix' in Blueprint Knowledge results in an empty filtered risk list

cause: filterRiskExplorerByBundle() injects the bundle name into generic text search rather than querying the relational mapping (BUNDLE_ANNEX_MAPPING) or setting the bundle filter.
plan: Update filterRiskExplorerByBundle() and renderRiskExplorer() to filter by BUNDLE_ANNEX_MAPPING[bundleKey].jointRisks and set the bundle selector correctly.

plan: Add onclick="openItemDetailModal('risk', '${r.id}')" and expandable detail sections to Team Google risk cards, ensuring full inspection of root cause, mitigations, and Blueprint traceability.

plan: Consolidate 'Open in NotebookLM' and 'Sync Notebook' controls directly into the global #sheetsModal popup, unifying all 4 external sync streams into one cohesive modal.

title: 5x5 Heatmap Matrix axes and labels are inverted / opposite
description: In both the Joint Program and Team Google 5x5 matrices, the axes and labels are inverted: the top horizontal column headers display Likelihood ratings (1 Rare to 5 Almost Certain) with a misleading label 'Consequence ↓', while the vertical row headers display Consequence levels (Catastrophic to Minor). The matrix orientation and axis headers need to be aligned with the canonical standard.
cause: Top-left axis label 'Consequence ↓' above horizontal Likelihood columns (1 Rare to 5 Almost Certain) and vertical Consequence rows causes confusion about matrix orientation.
plan: Standardize matrix axis headers across both Joint and Team Google heatmaps: add explicit 'Likelihood (X-Axis) →' column banner, 'Consequence (Y-Axis) ↓' row indicator, and unambiguous cell coordinates.

title: Joint Program risk cards and Team Google risk cards have inconsistent interaction patterns
description: Risk statement cards across the Joint Program tab and Team Google tab have inconsistent interactions and button affordances: Joint Program cards feature in-line expandable accordions ('▾ View Root Cause & Mitigation'), while Team Google cards use modal popups ('Inspect Full Detail ↗'). Both card systems should share the unified, canonical design system with both in-line expansion and full detail modal inspection.
cause: renderRiskExplorer and renderTeamGoogleRiskExplorer use divergent card templates (in-line accordion vs modal popup trigger).
plan: Unify risk card templates across both registers so all cards support BOTH in-line accordion expansion ('▾ View Root Cause & Mitigation') and full modal inspection ('Inspect Full Detail ↗'), with consistent Blueprint badges and control deltas.

title: Executive Summary Audio Podcast briefing refers to stale Week 26 instead of current Week 27
description: In index.html, toggleTranscriptModal() calls renderPodcastTranscript(), which reads from PODCAST_SCRIPTS[activeTimeMachineWeek] || PODCAST_SCRIPTS.w26. PODCAST_SCRIPTS only has 'w26' hardcoded, and its objects lack 'avatar' and 'role' properties, causing '${line.avatar}' and '${line.role}' to display as 'undefined' in the modal dialog.
cause: PODCAST_SCRIPTS structure in index.html lacks Week 27 entry and misses avatar, role, and time fields.
plan: Add PODCAST_SCRIPTS.w27 with full dialogue for Week 27 (07 Aug 2026) and populated avatar ('🎙️' / '🤖'), role ('Program Analyst' / 'Technical Director'), and time fields.

cause: Top 5 Critical Risks and Top 5 Escalated Issues containers are unpopulated in renderExecBriefing.
plan: Restore renderTop5Risks and renderTop5Issues functions to populate ranked tables with score badges and 1-click modal inspection triggers.

title: 5x5 Heatmap Matrix axes are inconsistent between Team Google and Joint Program

cause: Team Google matrix loops X as Severity and Y as Likelihood, conflicting with Joint matrix orientation.
plan: Standardize BOTH matrices strictly with X-axis as Likelihood (1 Rare to 5 Almost Certain) and Y-axis as Consequence/Severity (5 Catastrophic down to 1 Minor).

cause: Team Google Risks tab lacks visible active filter banner and Clear Filter button above explorer container.
plan: Add active filter banner with '✕ Clear Matrix Filter' and 'Reset Filters' buttons above Team Google Risk Explorer, and support clicking active cell to toggle off.

title: Issue Detail inspection modal lacks Contract Blueprint Traceability and NotebookLM link

cause: openItemDetailModal for issues does not generate Contract Blueprint Traceability card.
plan: Add Contract Blueprint Traceability card (with mapped Annex badge, bundle, and 'Open in NotebookLM ↗' link) to openItemDetailModal for issues.

title: CD1 Driver Tree deliverable cards and risk/issue badges lack click-to-drill-down interactions
description: In the CD1 Driver Tree tab, deliverable cards (e.g. Ref 1.1, Ref 1.2b, Ref 1.10b) and their sub-badges ('Risks: X', 'Issues: Y', 'Gap Close Plan #Z') are static and non-interactive. Clicking a deliverable card or its risk/issue badge should open a drill-down detail modal or jump directly to the filtered risk/issue views with the matching driver reference and Blueprint Annex.
cause: CD1 Driver Tree deliverable cards and risk/issue/gap badges have no click handlers.
plan: Wire click handlers on deliverable cards, risk badges, and issue badges to jump directly to filtered Risk Explorer, Issue Register, and Blueprint Annexes.

title: Top 5 Critical Risks and Top 5 Issues cards in Executive Summary lack explicit drill-down actions
description: In the Executive Summary view, the Top 5 Critical Risks and Top 5 Escalated Issues cards need explicit, prominent drill-down capabilities (such as 'Inspect ↗' modal trigger and 1-click jump to the filtered Risk Explorer / Issue Register with Driver Tree ref and Blueprint Annex traceability).
cause: Top 5 risks and issues lists in Executive Summary lack explicit visual action buttons and deep filter jump handlers.
plan: Add explicit 'Inspect ↗' modal trigger buttons and 1-click filter jump links to Top 5 critical risks and escalated issues.

title: Executive Summary Audio Podcast player does not play audio
description: Audio podcast asset returns 404 on server: 'GET /assets/podcast_w27.mp3?v=au3 HTTP/1.1' 404 File not found and 'GET /assets/podcast_w27.wav?v=au3 HTTP/1.1' 404 File not found. The assets directory lacks podcast_w27 audio files.
cause: The physical audio file assets/podcast_w27.mp3 / assets/podcast_w27.wav was not generated on disk in the assets/ directory, causing HTML5 audio element to fail with 404.
plan: Generate a valid audio file (e.g. wav/mp3) in project_dash/assets/podcast_w27.mp3 (or assets/podcast_w27.wav) and ensure togglePodcastPlay uses Web Speech API synthesis or audio playback seamlessly.

title: Inspect Full Details button on Team Google Risk cards does not open the detail modal
description: In the Team Google Risks tab, clicking the 'Inspect Full Detail ↗' button on any Team Google risk card fails to open the inspection modal due to ID lookup mismatch or unhandled event parameter in openItemDetailModal().
cause: openItemDetailModal ID lookup uses strict equality on r.id/r.displayId which fails when matching integer/string ID types across LIVE_TEAM_GOOGLE_RISKS.
plan: Make openItemDetailModal ID comparison type-agnostic (String(r.id) === String(itemId)) across both LIVE_RISKS and LIVE_TEAM_GOOGLE_RISKS, ensuring modal opens reliably with full Team Google metadata and Blueprint Annex.

title: Risk cards in Joint Program and Team Google lack visible clickable links/badges into Blueprint Knowledge
description: On the Joint Program Risks and Team Google Risks tabs, individual risk cards in the Live Risk Explorer do not feature visible, clickable 'Blueprint: Annex X' badges or 'View Blueprint ↗' links navigating directly to the matching Solution Bundle in Blueprint Knowledge and opening the Project Monaro Contract Notebook.
cause: renderRiskExplorer and renderTeamGoogleRiskExplorer templates do not resolve BUNDLE_ANNEX_MAPPING or render clickable Blueprint Annex badges on card headers.
plan: Resolve mapped Annex for every risk via BUNDLE_ANNEX_MAPPING and render a visible, clickable '📘 Blueprint: Annex X' badge and 'View Blueprint ↗' link jumping to Blueprint Knowledge with NotebookLM deep links.

title: Issue Register table column widths and horizontal overflow cut off Severity, Action Plan, and Details
description: In the Issue Register view, excessive column width in 'Driver Ref' (which prints full multi-line title strings) and 'Issue Statement & Name' causes horizontal overflow that crops off the Severity, Governance Action Plan, and Details columns off the right edge of the screen. Column widths need clean proportional balancing and Driver Ref needs to render the concise ref tag (e.g. Ref 1.10b).
cause: Driver Ref column renders long un-truncated title strings, and table lacks column width constraints, pushing Severity, Action Plan, and Details off-screen.
plan: Format Driver Ref as compact badge (e.g. Ref 1.10b), apply table-fixed layout with proportional column widths (ID, Status, Owner, Ref, Statement, Severity, Action Plan, Action), ensuring all 8 columns fit on screen.

title: Issue Register Inspect button / row click fails to open the issue detail modal
description: In the Issue Register view (tab-issues), clicking the 'Inspect ↗' action or clicking any issue row fails to open the item detail modal due to ID resolution mismatch or event propagation issue in openItemDetailModal('issue', id).
cause: openItemDetailModal ID lookup on LIVE_ISSUES fails when resolving numeric ID vs displayId strings, or row click event handling is blocked.
plan: Make openItemDetailModal ID matching strictly type-agnostic (String(i.id) === targetIdStr || String(i.displayId) === targetIdStr) across LIVE_ISSUES, and add explicit Inspect button on each row.

title: Gap #1 jump button does not scroll/highlight target Gap Close Plan and lacks Back to Briefing navigation
description: When in the Executive Summary tab, after clicking Gap pills/jump links to inspect gap close plans, the back button navigates to the top of the Driver Tree tab instead of returning to Executive Summary.
cause: jumpToGapClose uses fragile querySelectorAll('div') innerText matching, and lacks deterministic element IDs and history/scroll state tracking.
plan: Add explicit DOM IDs (id='gap-close-plan-X') in renderExecGapClosePlans(), update jumpToGapClose to use document.getElementById with smooth scroll and highlight pulse, push history state, and render a floating '↑ Return to Executive Briefing' return button.

title: Transcript modal renders large 'undefined' avatar badges, '(undefined)' role labels, and stale Episode 26 subtitle
description: In the Executive Summary view, opening the NotebookLM Deep Dive Transcript modal displays large 'undefined' badges on the left of each dialog row, '(undefined)' next to speaker names (Alex & Jordan), and a subtitle hardcoding 'Episode 26: The I-129 Breakthrough & SRR Glide Path (Alex & Jordan)' and Week 26 text. The modal renderer template and active week state must populate valid avatars ('🎙️' / '🤖'), timestamps ('0:00'), roles ('Program Analyst' / 'Technical Director'), and Week 27 Episode 27 metadata.
cause: User verified latest build with valid Week 27 dialog, avatars, speaker roles, and timestamps.
plan: Verified fixed in index.html (8ce33bc).

title: Issue Register table cuts off vertically after 3 rows and does not fill viewport height
description: In the Issue Register view (tab-issues), the table only shows ~3 rows before cutting off vertically, leaving extensive empty whitespace at the bottom of the viewport instead of filling the full vertical container height.
cause: User was viewing old browser cache prior to Phase 4 & 5 dynamic viewport height stretch fixes.
plan: Verified fixed in latest index.html build.

title: Header 'Open Sheet' button only links to one sheet, but there are now two live Google Sheets (Joint Program & Team Google)
description: In the top header navigation bar, the 'Open Sheet ↗' button only links to the single Joint Program Risk Register. Since the platform now ingests and tracks both the Joint Program Register and the dedicated Team Google Risk Register, the header button should provide a multi-sheet dropdown selector or quick links to open either the Joint Program Sheet or the Team Google Sheet.
cause: Header 'Open Sheet' button hardcodes a single sheet URL and lacks a multi-sheet selection dropdown for Team Google.
plan: Convert 'Open Sheet' into an interactive dropdown popover with 1-click links for Joint Program Register (107 risks), Team Google Register (12 risks), and Drive folder.

title: CD1 Driver Tree cards have large empty whitespace gaps when items lack schedule shifts or Gap Close Plans
description: In the CD1 Driver Tree tab (v03), deliverable cards that lack schedule shift notes or Gap Close Plans (e.g. Ref 1.1, Ref 1.2a) display large awkward empty whitespace areas between the deliverable title and the completion progress bar due to inflexible flex/grid spacing and missing concise deliverable descriptions or milestone status metadata.
cause: Driver Tree cards omit deliverable scope descriptions and milestone status badges when items lack schedule shifts or Gap Close Plans, leaving empty whitespace boxes.
plan: Enrich deliverable data with concise scope summaries and milestone status indicators across all 25 cards, ensuring consistent vertical padding and zero empty whitespace gaps.

title: Gemini 3.5 Pro is not a real model - update branding to say Gemini
description: Gemini 3.5 Pro is not a real model. Update branding, badge text, synthesis headers, and documentation to refer simply to 'Gemini'.
cause: Historical branding referred to unreleased model version.
plan: Update references to Gemini across UI and documentation.
resolution_notes: Resolved by user: updated branding, badge text, and documentation to refer to Gemini.

title: Driver Tree gate deliverable cards related risks links/badges are not clickable
description: On the Driver Tree tab, users are unable to click into the related risks from deliverable cards to filter or view linked risks in the Risk Explorer.
cause: In renderDriverTree(), linked risks and issues counts (🚨 Risks: N / ⚠️ Issues: N) are rendered as static non-interactive <span> elements without click handlers or cursor pointer styling.
plan: Convert linked risks and issues badges into interactive clickable buttons with hover states. Add filterByDriverTreeRef(ref, type) to switch to the respective tab (overview or issues), apply the deliverable filter banner, and scroll to the matching items, or open a dedicated linked items drawer.
resolution_notes: Added interactive clickable badge buttons for linked risks and issues in renderDriverTree(). Implemented filterByDriverTreeDeliverable(refNumber, type) to switch to Joint Risks or Issue Register, apply the deliverable filter banner with matching counts, and smoothly scroll to the filtered items.

title: In-Dashboard Triggering for Data Ingestion, Google Sync, and Gemini Generation
description: Allow authenticated Dashboard Admins to trigger data ingestion pipelines (Google Sheets sync, Google Drive weekly PDF report ingestion, Gemini executive brief generation, and NotebookLM sync) directly from the dashboard UI via backend endpoints or Cloud Run Jobs.
cause: Backend endpoints (/api/ingest-data, /api/regenerate-briefing) are implemented in server.py, but the Workspace Sync Modal in index.html lacks direct UI trigger buttons and loading indicators for these actions.
plan: Add interactive Ingest All Data and Regenerate Gemini Briefing action buttons inside the Workspace Sync Hub modal with real-time spinners, status banners, and toast notifications.

title: Driver Tree deliverable cards render undefined for title, completion percentage, and target date
description: On the Driver Tree tab (observed on Project F-DSE), deliverable gate cards display 'undefined' for the main title/description, 'undefined%' for completion, and 'Target: undefined', while Ref and Owner fields populate properly.
cause: In index.html (capabilityDrops parser), gate objects are mapped with property 'name' and 'targetDate', but renderDriverTree() accesses item.description, item.completeBy, and item.progress, causing the cards to render undefined.
plan: Update the capabilityDrops gate mapping in index.html to set description = g.name || g.description, completeBy = g.dueDate || g.completeBy || cd.targetDate, and default progress = g.progress || 0, ensuring consistent field population.

title: Blueprint Knowledge tab cards render blank/empty for Solution Blueprints and Research sections
description: On the Blueprint Knowledge tab (observed on Project F-DSE view at ?project=f-dse#blueprints), top metadata cards populate (17 Files, 10 Bundles), but the 'Contract Solution Blueprints & Technical Annexes (A through L)' and 'Research, Governance & Supporting Documentation' containers render empty white boxes with no blueprint cards.
cause: data/f-dse/knowledge.json is missing the 'blueprints' array definition, and precompute_analytics.py only builds blueprintMappings when blueprints array exists, resulting in an empty blueprint mapping and blank containers.
plan: Add standardized solution blueprints array to data/f-dse/knowledge.json matching F-DSE contract annexes (Annexes B-L), rerun ingest_data.py to rebuild precomputed caches, and add graceful fallback in renderBlueprintKnowledge().

title: Performance Trends Risk Mitigation Score Performance (Burndown) chart is empty / blank
description: On the Performance Trends tab (observed on Project F-DSE view at ?project=f-dse#trends), the 'Risk Mitigation Score Performance (Burndown)' chart renders empty axes (0 to 25) with no lines or data points plotted for Inherent Avg Risk or Residual Avg Risk across weeks 22-27.
cause: Property name mismatch between precompute_analytics.py (which outputs burndown.inherentScores and burndown.residualScores) and index.html computeTimelineMetrics() (which expects t.burndown.inherentAvg and t.burndown.residualAvg).
plan: Update computeTimelineMetrics() in index.html to read t.burndown.inherentScores || t.burndown.inherentAvg, and ensure precompute_analytics.py populates both keys for backwards compatibility.

title: Clicking All status filter button on Team Google tab does not clear active 5x5 heatmap cell filter
description: On the Team Google Register tab (?project=f-dse#team-google), clicking the 'All (12)' status pill button updates the status selection but does not reset or clear the active 5x5 matrix cell selection (activeTeamGoogleMatrixCellFilter), leaving the explorer filtered to only the 2 risks from the previously clicked heatmap cell instead of showing all 12 risks.
cause: setTeamGoogleStatusFilter(status) in index.html updates status selection styling but does not reset teamGoogleActiveMatrixCellFilter to null, leaving the risk explorer locked to the previously selected 5x5 heatmap cell.
plan: Update setTeamGoogleStatusFilter() to clear teamGoogleActiveMatrixCellFilter and hide the matrix filter notice when switching status or selecting 'all'.

title: Header Sync button wraps onto a second line below project selector pill
description: In the top header bar, the 🔄 Sync button wraps onto a new second line directly underneath the Active project dropdown selector pill rather than staying aligned on a single horizontal row alongside Time Machine, Open Sheet, and Week Pack buttons.
cause: The header controls container has flex-wrap enabled with multiple large pill buttons and the project switcher dropdown, causing the Sync button to wrap to a second row on standard desktop viewports.
plan: Remove the redundant project dropdown (per FR #66), apply flex-nowrap to the header controls bar, and adjust button padding for clean single-line alignment.

title: Remove top-bar project switcher dropdown and rely exclusively on URL param and .env default
description: Remove the 'Active: Project Name ▾' dropdown switcher menu from the top header bar in index.html, simplifying the header layout and relying entirely on the ?project=<slug> URL search parameter and backend .env DEFAULT_PROJECT configuration.
cause: Top-bar project dropdown was added as a temporary test UI but is redundant with URL query parameter (?project=<slug>) and server-side .env DEFAULT_PROJECT configuration, while taking up excessive header horizontal width.
plan: Remove project dropdown menu markup and event handlers from index.html header, retaining top-bar project name badge (PROJECT AURORA vs AUSTRALIAN DEFENCE F-DSE) sourced dynamically from config.json.

title: Executive Briefing Audio Podcast is just chime sounds instead of full spoken briefing dialogue
description: When playing the Executive Briefing Audio Deep Dive in the dashboard, the audio playback plays synthesized chime tones (audio tone synthesis fallback) rather than generated dual-speaker Gemini voice audio discussing the weekly risk profile and executive action items.
cause: PODCAST_SCRIPTS reference was undefined after decoupling and snapshots.json had empty podcastScript arrays, causing the transcript modal to render blank and playPodcastFromIndex(0) to immediately exit without speaking.
plan: Populate snapshots.json with 5-part dialogue turns for all weeks, make renderPodcastTranscript, copyPodcastScript, and playPodcastFromIndex call getPodcastScriptForWeek(activeTimeMachineWeek), and speak dialogue aloud via Web Speech Synthesis.

title: Executive Briefing Top 5 Critical Risks and Top 5 Escalated Issues containers render blank / empty
description: At the bottom of the Executive Summary / Briefing tab (observed on Project F-DSE view at ?project=f-dse), the 'Top 5 Critical Risks' and 'Top 5 Escalated Issues' container sections render their headers (View Matrix, View Register) but contain no risk or issue cards inside, appearing as blank white containers.
cause: Top 5 Critical Risks and Top 5 Escalated Issues render empty when LIVE_RISKS or LIVE_ISSUES arrays are empty (e.g. if data failed to fetch on Cloud Run or if item.riskName is missing) without rendering fallback placeholder state.
plan: Ensure robust field fallbacks (r.riskName || r.riskDescription || r.title) and add friendly empty-state placeholder cards in renderTop5Risks() and renderTop5Issues() if 0 active items match.

title: Server returns 404 File not found for /favicon.ico requests
description: Browser requests for /favicon.ico result in 'code 404, message File not found' log entries in server.py output when clients navigate to the dashboard.
cause: Browser automatically requests /favicon.ico upon navigation, and server.py SimpleHTTPRequestHandler returns 404 because no favicon.ico file exists in the workspace root.
plan: Add a lightweight favicon handler in server.py (or provide an embedded SVG/ICO favicon file) returning 200 OK / 204 No Content to eliminate 404 console logs.

title: Driver tree deliverable list only renders 6 items and may be incomplete
description: The Driver Tree & Gap Close Horizon tab displays "6 Deliverables" and only 6 deliverable cards under CD1 (Ref 1.2b, Ref 1.6 GFF, Ref 1.10b, Ref 1.14, Ref 1.15, Ref 3.1). Need to verify whether the driver_tree.json or capability drop structure contains more Level 2/3 gates and work packages across CD1, CD1.5, CD2, or if cards are being filtered/truncated prematurely.
cause: data/f-dse/driver_tree.json contained a 6-item stub instead of the 24 contractual capability drop gates and Level 2/3 work packages referenced across the 119 risks, 29 issues, and project documentation.
plan: 1. Enrich driver_tree.json with the full 24 capability drop gates across CD1.0, CD1.5, and CD2.0. 2. Tag Level 2 primary gates vs Level 3 work packages. 3. Verify driver tree level filter tabs (All, Level 2, Level 3) in index.html.

title: Early warning sleeper outlier box renders empty labels when unpopulated and lacks robust content
description: In the Executive Summary section, the "Early Warning Sleeper Outlier" card renders with empty placeholder text ("The Risk: Trigger:") when sleeper outlier fields are unpopulated or malformed in snapshots.json. If there is no sleeper outlier data for a snapshot, the container should be hidden completely; if data exists (or can be identified across the 107+ risks), it should render the full risk title, trigger condition, and strategic mitigation details.
cause: snapshots.json stored description instead of risk/trigger, and index.html lacked property fallbacks and failed to hide the container when outlier content was empty, leaving empty placeholder labels.
plan: 1. In index.html, hide #sleeperOutlierContainer if outlier is empty/missing, and add property fallbacks (sl.risk || sl.description || sl.title, sl.trigger || sl.action). 2. Populate snapshots.json with rich risk and trigger details for dormant high-impact items.

title: Podcast audio playback is robotic and lost natural voices
description: The Executive Briefing audio player is currently using standard browser Web Speech Synthesis (window.speechSynthesis), which sounds mechanical/robotic compared to studio-grade natural multi-speaker audio (e.g., generated via Gemini 3-series multimodal audio APIs or Google Cloud Multi-Speaker Text-to-Speech).
cause: Web Speech Synthesis fallback uses local client OS synthesizers, which lack neural intonation and conversational cadence.
plan: 1. Support pre-generated dual-speaker studio audio tracks (MP3/WAV) in assets/ or GCS. 2. Implement server-side audio generation using Gemini 3 series or Google Cloud TTS Multi-Speaker voices. 3. Gracefully switch between high-fidelity studio audio and client speech synthesis.

title: Podcast audio is for week 26, but transcript is for week 27
description: The audio asset being played by the podcast player is the Week 26 recording, while the transcript and dashboard display Week 27 content.

title: Gap pill back button navigates to top of Driver Tree tab instead of returning to Executive Summary
description: When in the Executive Summary tab, after clicking Gap pills / jump links to inspect gap close plans, the back button takes the user to the top of the Driver Tree tab rather than returning to the Executive Summary.
root_cause: Duplicate of Bug #53 (Gap navigation and return to Executive Summary).
